scope: Observed-data source planning for related scientific questions. Inspected one new cell-annotation CSV and existing vendored mammary counts/sample metadata; no new expression matrices or raw reads downloaded. No new task is implemented or candidate cleared for training export.

policy.reuse_unit: Share acquisition, identity reconciliation and native environment preparation across compatible questions. Each task still answers one coherent question and retains its own complete private oracle/verifier contract.
policy.realism: Keep the biological replicate count and observation structure needed by the estimand. Bound cells, loci or genomic regions by declared outcome-independent eligibility, not by selecting observations that force a desired answer.
policy.single_split: The corpus has one train split. Held-out subjects, cells or observations inside a predictive task are part of its scientific evaluation protocol, with evaluation labels private to the verifier.
policy.no_automatic_coverage: A source's availability or a question's eligibility does not establish benchmark endpoint equivalence. Preserve benchmark biological-context and method departures explicitly.
policy.lineage_screen: Check accessions, DOI, project IDs, originating cohorts and known mirrors against all permitted ID-source metadata before authoring. Absence of an identifier match is only a preliminary screen. Uninspected/gated source fixtures prevent a universal nonoverlap claim. Do not deanonymize OOD inputs.
policy.metadata_only: Inspected primary landing pages, versioned manifests, one Lawlor cell-annotation CSV, existing vendored GSE60450 counts/GEO metadata and two small independent provider sample sheets. No new expression/protein matrix, raw read, image or benchmark answer was fetched in this source review.

collections.metadata_evidence: Pinned HCA dcp60 metadata lists RNA, ADT and HTO RDS matrices, one cell-annotation CSV and an ingest workbook. The downloaded CSV hash matches the provider: 282,528 unique cell IDs, ten donor labels and ten sequencing runs. It includes IgM_IgG in addition to the paper’s three conditions. Exactly 16,382 rows have a non-NA cell-type label, all are HTO condition singlets and Demuxlet SNG, and all ten donors have cells in each of Baseline, CD3_CD28 and LPS. Matrix axes and count-layer semantics remain uninspected.
collections.proposed_input_boundary: Keep native RDS files and the complete source annotation CSV as provenance. Require exact cell-ID/feature joins and verify raw integer count layers before deriving sparse H5AD/MuData task inputs. Source RNA, ADT and HTO objects may contain different cell sets; do not infer their axes from filenames.
collections.proposed_sampling: For label-based characterization and paired pseudobulk, first evaluate the complete 16,382 labelled cells across all ten donors and three declared conditions. For protein prediction, separately evaluate the 53,707 HTO/Demuxlet singlets without a protein-derived label filter. Preserve all eligible biological donors; no further downsampling is justified by the portal estimate alone.
scientific_limits: Healthy immune stimulation does not establish disease, tissue-residence, age or genotype effects.
Condition response is observed; it does not provide labels for an unseen genetic perturbation and does not cover a CRISPR generalization endpoint.
Cross-donor protein imputation requires private held-out measured ADT values, not an imputed reference used as truth.

Protein-informed source cell labels are attributed reference annotations, not an independent gold standard. Freeze label evidence and report circularity; use protein evidence only when independent of the measured target.
Pairing is at donor level across separately measured condition samples; the same cell is not observed before and after treatment. RNA and ADT modalities are paired within a measured cell.
The three conditions are a matched ex vivo comparison, not a longitudinal time series. A condition called Baseline is not proof of an earlier collection time.
Non-NA donor fields also occur on DBL and AMB rows; donor presence alone cannot define a valid singlet. Run identifiers describe technical partitions, not ten additional biological replicates.

The labelled cohort was selected and annotated using protein evidence. Predicting the same protein measurements from RNA requires auditing both selection leakage and derived input labels; hiding query ADT alone is insufficient.

Four monocyte donor-condition strata are empty. Missing cells cannot be turned into zero-expression pseudobulk samples; cell-composition zeros and missing gene-expression estimates have different meanings.

release_metadata.license: HCA project page declares CC BY 4.0 for downloaded/exported data; retain project and publication attribution.

annotation_inspection.donor_alias_rule: Sort the ten exact source Donor_of_Origin strings lexicographically, then assign donor-01 through donor-10. Keep the input-derived mapping for reproducibility.

annotated_subset.rule: Celltype_Annotation != NA; verify HTO_Classification in the three declared conditions and Demuxlet_Classification == SNG before use.

pre_adt_label_selection_candidate.rule: HTO_Classification in Baseline/CD3_CD28/LPS and Demuxlet_Classification == SNG; no Celltype_Annotation filter.
pre_adt_label_selection_candidate.qualification: Candidate selection predicate uses no cell-type label, but source classifier dependencies and RNA/ADT matrix identities must still be audited. It is not a validated protein-prediction input.

source_discrepancies: The portal estimate is 250,000 cells; the deposited annotation CSV contains 282,528 rows and an additional IgM_IgG condition. Use explicit per-task inclusion rules, not the portal estimate as a matrix dimension.

The article reports 195,480 captured droplets and 55,353 cells at an intermediate filtering stage. The inspected CSV predicate for three-condition HTO/Demuxlet singlets yields 53,707; this does not reproduce that intermediate number. Resolve the original filtering/version difference before claiming full pipeline reproduction.
The 16,382 labelled cells match the article’s final count. That equality does not prove matrix identity, per-cell label correctness or reproduction of the original pipeline.

question_input_decisions.decision: Paired design confirmed in metadata; count layers remain unresolved.
question_input_decisions.planned_boundary: Retain all ten donors and three conditions. A proposed minimum of 20 cells per donor-condition retains CD4T_Mem, CD4T_Naive, CD8T_Mem and CD8T_Naive across all 30 strata. Keep eligibility decisions for B, NK and CD14_Mono explicit. Aggregate cells to donor/cell-type/condition counts; fit the required native paired model with donor blocking and declared condition contrasts.
question_input_decisions.invalidation: Do not impute zero-expression samples for absent lineages or treat cells as donor replicates.

question_input_decisions.decision: Complete annotation and three matrix file identities found; raw-layer/QC feature inspection pending.
question_input_decisions.planned_boundary: Preserve unannotated, ambiguous, empty and multiplet dispositions in the input QC ledger. Use source labels only as attributed reference annotations; native SingleR and representation requirements remain separate.
question_input_decisions.invalidation: Starting from the final labelled subset alone cannot validate removal of all original low-quality droplets.

question_input_decisions.decision: Ten donor groups and seven final labels support a candidate donor-separated design.
question_input_decisions.planned_boundary: Run the specified native classifier with reference/query donors separated before fitting and keep evaluation labels private. Report agreement with protein-informed source labels. Fix features and normalization using training donors only.
question_input_decisions.invalidation: This is not independent gold-standard cell identity; include explicit uncertainty/unknown-label rules and avoid label-derived query features.

question_input_decisions.decision: Separate candidate pool identified; no data package or model validation yet.
question_input_decisions.planned_boundary: Inspect matched counts for the 53,707 HTO/Demuxlet singlets. Audit protein-dependent filtering upstream; remove ADT-derived annotations and features from query inputs. Separate donors in training/tuning/evaluation, retain every eligible measured protein and run the required native totalVI model.
question_input_decisions.invalidation: The 16,382-cell protein-selected cohort cannot be used as an unbiased prediction benchmark without a declared selection-conditioned estimand. RNA-only baseline methods do not substitute for required totalVI execution.

question_input_decisions.decision: Final labelled cohort has 16,382 cells and seven source populations; joint matrices remain uninspected.
question_input_decisions.planned_boundary: Use matched observed RNA/ADT and antibody/control identities, preserve modality-specific normalization, and compare complete marker/label evidence with source-derived annotations.
question_input_decisions.invalidation: Do not claim independent label validation from the same ADT markers used to define those labels.

acquisition_and_runtime_plan.remote_only_reason: RNA RDS is 480,584,213 compressed bytes; decoded sparse objects and conversion temporaries can exceed the 500 MiB local working-set limit. Inspect native R objects and prepare task inputs on authorized remote compute.
required_preparation_checks: Record R classes, dimensions, feature/cell IDs, integer/nonnegative count semantics and every stored layer.
Join RNA/ADT/HTO by exact run-qualified cell IDs and report missing/duplicated axes.
Preserve the source donor/condition/label map and every selection decision.
Measure task runtime before claiming the 30-minute target, especially native totalVI.

lineage_review.limit: Only permitted public ID metadata checked; uninspected/gated fixtures and cohorts can still overlap. No OOD contents inspected.

collections.metadata_evidence: GEO describes early and late septic groups and healthy controls measured with CITE-seq. The public release enumerates 34 GEX/ADT libraries and a 516.9 MB archive of MTX/TXT files. The study description and deposited library counts must be reconciled before assigning biological sample counts. A dataset-specific redistribution license was not established from the reviewed metadata.
collections.proposed_input_boundary: Observed matched GEX/ADT matrices plus explicit subject and collection-time metadata; use the actual released subjects and sample identifiers.
collections.proposed_sampling: Preserve observed subject groups and all qualifying biological units. Do not interpret different early and late subjects as repeated measurements.
scientific_limits: The cohort mixes myeloid enrichment and Ficoll enrichment. Apparent cell proportions may reflect sampling protocol and cannot automatically be interpreted as in vivo abundance.
Sepsis state and recovery labels are observational; no causal treatment effect follows from this input alone.
The stated cohort size is larger than the enumerated release subset. A source summary cannot replace an actual sample manifest.

collections.metadata_evidence: GEO enumerates 83 libraries spanning GEX, TCR and BCR, with preterm/term cord blood, infant ages and adult samples. Its 1.4 GB processed archive contains CSV/MTX/TSV. The inspected BCR sample provides filtered contig annotations. Repeated sample numbers are not assumed to be globally unique people. Dataset-specific redistribution rights remain unconfirmed.
collections.proposed_input_boundary: Observed receptor contigs, RNA counts and a release-derived sample/donor/age map. Native sequence reassignment requires observed contig sequences and reference segment records, not only precomputed V/J labels.
collections.proposed_sampling: Retain complete selected donor/visit/repertoire records, chain ambiguity and no-receptor cells. Bound to a declared cohort or visit range without filtering on expansion or response.
scientific_limits: This source can support repertoire and developmental-state questions, but it does not supply tumor exhaustion, cancer treatment response or a recorded CD8 sorting gate.
Age groups cannot be declared longitudinal without an explicit donor-visit map.
Starting from observed contigs exercises annotation and downstream repertoire analysis; it does not cover assembly from raw reads.
BCR gene usage and TCR state association remain separate scientific questions even when they share a study.

collections.metadata_evidence: The Dryad README describes one 100-micrometer cortical sample with 242 measured genes and one 200-micrometer hypothalamic sample with 156 genes, each from one P56 male animal. It specifies cell-by-gene tables, segmented-cell coordinates and transcript coordinates in micrometers. The processed ZIP is 3.75 GB; raw imaging is about 3 TB and is not deposited there. Exact version/file checksums and dataset-license metadata still need capture.
collections.proposed_input_boundary: Observed cell-by-gene matrix and segmented-cell x/y/z coordinates from one declared volume, with codebook, field identities and coordinate units. Preserve the measured targeted gene panel.
collections.proposed_sampling: Use a complete declared volume or geometrically bounded region, retaining edge/field indicators. Do not fabricate z coordinates, unmeasured genes or independent animals by dividing one volume.
scientific_limits: Within-volume spatial counting and conditional label-randomization are feasible planning targets. The source does not establish replicated between-condition or between-animal inference.
Cortex and hypothalamus with different panels cannot be treated as interchangeable biological replicates.
Processed-coordinate tasks do not exercise segmentation from raw imaging, and the deposited gene panel cannot establish genome-wide spatial coverage.

collections.proposed_input_boundary: Keep all 27,179 observed Entrez gene rows, exon lengths, twelve count columns and GEO sample metadata as input. Select one population and a declared developmental contrast for a coherent task; retain its six libraries across three stages for estimation. Derive eligibility by the declared count filter and keep excluded genes with reasons. Join sample identities by full supplementary filename, never metadata row order.
scientific_limits: Wild-type female FVB/N mouse mammary populations across virgin, pregnancy and lactation stages do not establish disease case/control or genetic-perturbation effects. Any such benchmark mapping remains a biological-context adaptation.

There are two libraries per population and developmental stage. Replicate numbers do not establish donor pairing across stages or basal/luminal populations; do not invent a donor block or treat the stages as repeated measures.

Inspected metadata provides no documented failed replicate. Removing one sample leaves only one in that stage, so this source is rejected for the proposed evidence-backed replicate-QC exclusion question.
Bulk sorted populations do not exercise single-cell preprocessing or pseudobulk aggregation. The Liu PyDESeq2 task is an explicit count-model adaptation.
Existing native/oracle/Harbor evidence covers the authored RNA task only. The R preparation uses betaPrior=FALSE and does not run apeglm, PyDESeq2, GSEA or semantic term reduction.
The existing mouse GO membership asset is BP-only. The term-label table has no ontology edges; neither supplies a complete semantic graph or a KEGG snapshot.
Count bytes match the Zenodo record declared CC BY 4.0. Retain the deposit and original study citations. This does not confer redistribution rights on additional ontology/pathway snapshots.
The Zenodo tutorial FASTQs contain 1,000 reads each and cannot substantiate a full raw-read workflow. The observed gene-count matrix retains the original count totals.
Expanded benchmark-cohort lineage review remains open. Sample-sheet agreement and a public license do not establish independence from every ID benchmark input.

input_inspection.sample_sheet_join_rule: Replace only the MCL1. filename prefix with MCL1-; join by full count-column name, never row order. pregnant = 18.5 dP; lactate = 2 dL.

rejected_question_or_card_ids.reason: No documented failed replicate in inspected metadata; two libraries per stage do not support removing a replicate while retaining replicated groups.

question_input_reviews.proposed_question: Which luminal expression changes between virgin and lactating mammary tissue are supported by the observed counts, and which biological processes agree between selected-gene and ranked-gene analyses?
question_input_reviews.design: Use all six luminal libraries with ~stage, virgin as reference and the 2 dL versus virgin coefficient. Pregnancy libraries support model estimation. Keep raw inputs and use population-specific rowSum >= 10; the current data yields 16,659 eligible genes. Freeze filtering, missing estimates, outlier handling and independent filtering in the task contract.
question_input_reviews.native_contract: Run pinned DESeq2 with an explicit coefficient for apeglm shrinkage. Report both unshrunken Wald statistics and shrunken effects without silently changing p-values. Run the specified clusterProfiler enrichment/semantic methods and a pinned GSEA method against frozen offline annotations; existing unshrunken references cannot stand in for these runs.
question_input_reviews.set_contract: ORA background is the eligible, tested and identifier-mapped population, explicitly intersected with the declared annotation domain. Preserve excluded/unmapped IDs. GSEA uses every eligible finite signed Wald statistic, with deterministic tie ordering, duplicate-ID resolution, set-size bounds and a frozen random seed when applicable. Test all eligible sets and state each multiplicity family.
question_input_reviews.complete_artifacts: Counts/metadata join and filter decisions; design and coefficient; all gene statistics and shrinkage results; identifier map; complete term memberships, universe, ORA and GSEA outputs including nonsignificant/undefined rows; native semantic neighborhoods and retained/removal IDs; numeric plot tables and optional supporting plots.
question_input_reviews.source_endpoint_limits: GSE60450 is a mouse developmental candidate, not human ASXL1 disease or fibroblast data. It cannot satisfy KEGG_2021_Human or establish equivalence to GO_Biological_Process_2021. The 17-record group remains conditional on compatible species/tissue and reference releases; no orthology conversion or live replacement library can silently clear it. PromptBio b-10-8 stays separate. Raw-p/adjusted-p plots, significant-only/top-absolute-NES tables and ORA backgrounds must remain distinct.
deterministic_rejection_cases: shuffle sample labels without changing counts
reverse the contrast or ranking sign
use significant genes as the ORA background
substitute ORA output for ranked GSEA
substitute raw p for adjusted p in a required plot
question_input_reviews.unresolved_inputs: A compatible frozen ontology graph and gene mapping for semantic similarity; a licensed/versioned KEGG snapshot for KEGG-specific targets; expanded source-cohort lineage.
question_input_reviews.runtime_requirement: Measure the complete offline Harbor oracle and verifier within the 30-minute target. No inference from the existing unshrunken fit runtime.
question_input_reviews.visual_scoring_scope: Grade the numerical biological and plot-data outputs; defer subjective or unsupported figure scoring, preserve component-only mappings, and do not delay viable numerical tasks.

question_input_reviews.proposed_question: Which luminal developmental-stage effects remain supported under an explicit native PyDESeq2 count model and fold-change shrinkage?
question_input_reviews.input_contract: Use the same six luminal libraries, documented three-stage design, virgin reference and observed count filter as the count-model proposal. Keep counts as integers and preserve the Entrez identifiers; do not relabel bulk libraries as cells.
question_input_reviews.native_contract: Run pinned PyDESeq2, including its shrinkage implementation. Retain count/design axes, size factors, dispersions, complete Wald results and shrunken effects. Freeze its fitting, outlier and filtering settings explicitly. R DESeq2 is a diagnostic cross-check with method-specific numerical limits, not the acceptance oracle.
question_input_reviews.acceptance_contract: A private PyDESeq2 script recomputes from public inputs. Independently check sample/contrast identities, count filtering, complete result universes and BH adjustment; reject shuffled metadata, reversed coefficients and omitted results. Fix tolerances from native repeatability before export.
question_input_reviews.source_endpoint_departure: The benchmark uses synthetic examples and requests a count matrix. This proposal uses observed bulk counts and asks for full fitted statistics; preserve that adaptation in coverage records.
question_input_reviews.unresolved_before_assignment: Pinned PyDESeq2 environment and measured runtime; complete numerical/output schema; expanded source-cohort lineage review.

scientific_limits: Exact mirror/deposit identity remains unresolved. Local metric checks do not make the complete scientific task validated.
Precomputed ortholog alignments/trees do not exercise discovery, raw sequence alignment or de novo inference.
Preserve the diagnosed native rooting behavior and its explicit reference convention; do not silently change metric semantics.

preliminary_lineage_screen.scope: Versioned benchmark inventories and cached permitted JSON/JSONL/Markdown source metadata. Biological fixtures, expected answers and OOD inputs were not inspected.
preliminary_lineage_screen.finding: No explicit accession/project/DOI match found in the inspected metadata. A numerical substring hit on 90029 was a Git object hash and is not lineage evidence.
preliminary_lineage_screen.remaining: Resolve originating study accessions and exact files against all accessible source descriptions. Uninspected/gated inputs leave residual lineage uncertainty.
